summary: Expose source and ingest coverage across API MCP and web
description: Publish current ACM catalog statistics and rights-aware reputation-source coverage through canonical HTTP, MCP, CLI, transparency, and web surfaces without exposing real number inventories or copied reports.
acceptance: API, CLI, stdio MCP, hosted MCP, and web expose one source-coverage projection with ACM imported range count, status and destination coverage, source digest/freshness, indexed service count, licensable feed count, enabled reputation source count, and explicit unavailable reasons.
Coverage reveals no raw number inventory, holder name, report text, reporter, lookup demand, credential, or private source data and never presents source count as trust or safety.

Desktop and 375px mobile browser proof is current, readable, unclipped, free of overflow and console errors, and visually distinguishes available official context from unavailable reputation coverage.
